name: @vytches/example-matrix
description: VD-006a — generates the examples/* package x combination coverage matrix (matrix.json + docs/COVERAGE-MATRIX.md) from actual repo state via TypeScript AST parsing. This is an ADDITIONAL report alongside the L1/L2/L3 test-pyramid coverage gate (vitest --coverage) — it does NOT replace or measure unit-test coverage quality, only whether a declared package combination has a real example file backed by a passing test.
